name: Alpengasthof Grüner
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Alpengasthof Grüner is located in Serfaus on a sunny plateau above the Inntal valley. This family-run establishment blends traditional architecture with modern comfort. The rooms are furnished with local woods and offer stunning views of the surrounding mountain landscape. The restaurant serves Austrian and Tyrolean specialties, with a focus on regional products. In summer, the guesthouse serves as a starting point for hiking and bike tours in the Naturpark Kaunergrat. In winter, guests can take the skibus directly from the house to the lifts in the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis ski area. A wellness area with sauna and steam bath completes the accommodation. Guests enjoy a peaceful setting with direct access to hiking and skiing trails.
